keyLimits.en: Minimum 3 seats. Unlimited US/Canada calls, SMS/MMS, 250+ integrations, 50 AI Voice Agent minutes/month, 6 months of dashboard analytics history.
Minimum 3 seats. Adds AI call summaries and conversation intelligence, smart routing, queue callback, Power Dialer, outbound campaigns, live monitoring, full API access.
Minimum 25 seats. Unlimited global calls, HIPAA/GDPR/SOC2 compliance, SSO and SCIM, dedicated support and developer API access.

addOns.en: AI Voice Agents: from $100/month minimum, plus included minutes per plan.

cautions.en: Essentials and Professional require a minimum of 3 seats, and Enterprise a minimum of 25, so the advertised per-seat price cannot be bought for a single user.
International outbound calling is billed separately (rates on request) except on Enterprise, which includes unlimited global calls.

capabilities.en: Cloud-based business phone system with call routing, IVR and shared numbers for sales and support teams.
AI call summaries and conversation intelligence (sentiment, key topics, talk-to-listen ratio) on Professional and above.
Deep CRM and helpdesk integrations including HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Zoho CRM, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom and Help Scout.
Power Dialer and outbound campaign tools for sales teams on the Professional plan.

limitations.en: No free plan; all paid tiers require a minimum seat count (3 for Essentials/Professional, 25 for Enterprise).
Advanced conversation intelligence and full API access are locked behind the Professional tier, not available on Essentials.

reason.en: Cloud business phone competitor aimed at smaller teams with lower per-seat pricing.
Sales-focused cloud calling platform with power dialer, overlapping with Aircall's Professional tier.
Customer communication platform with call/support workflows adjacent to Aircall's use case.

missingAlternatives.name: RingCentral
missingAlternatives.reason: Major cloud business phone/VoIP competitor, not present in the seed candidate list.
